info.name: NGINX njs Scripting Connections Stream Server Zones API
NGINX Return Status of All Stream Server Zones

params.name: fields
params.description: Limits which fields of server zones will be output. If the “<literal>fields</literal>” value is empty, then only server zone names will be output.

items.docs: Returns status information for each stream [server zone](https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_api_module.html#status_zone).

info.name: NGINX Return Status of a Stream Server Zone

params.name: streamServerZoneName
params.description: The name of a stream server zone.

params.name: fields
params.description: Limits which fields of the server zone will be output.

items.docs: Returns status of a particular stream server zone.

info.name: NGINX Reset Statistics for a Stream Server Zone

params.name: streamServerZoneName
params.description: The name of a stream server zone.

items.docs: Resets statistics of accepted and discarded connections, sessions, received and sent bytes, counters of SSL handshakes and session reuses in a particular stream server zone.
